name: Pigeonhole XOR Obfuscation
description: Conceals an exact-cover/3D-matching constraint by converting the distinctness requirement into a target state of an array updated via bitwise XOR. Because there are exactly k operations and k indices, the only way to avoid leaving any index at 0 (which would fail the target state) is to hit every index exactly once. Models that literally translate the XOR operations will write a simulation-based backtracking search without early pruning, leading to TLE, whereas models that mathematically deduce the pigeonhole constraint will recover the exact-cover structure.
